raw_segments.text: Suddenly, the waters around them slowly swelled in broad circles, then quickly up heaved,
as if sideways sliding from a submerged burg of ice, swiftly rising to the surface.
A low rumbling sound was heard, a subterraneous hum, and then all held their breaths, as bedraggled
with trailing ropes and harpoons and lances, a vast form shot lengthwise but obliquely
Shrouded in a thin, drooping veil of mist, it hovered for a moment in the rainbowed air,
and then fell swamping back into the deep.
Crushed thirty feet upwards, the waters flashed for an instant like heaps of fountains, then
brokenly sank in a shower of flakes, leaving the circling surface creamed like new milk
round the marble trunk of the whale.
